interpretations: For each event, average its nonmissing budget amounts; keep events whose average exceeds the average of all nonmissing budget amounts; show the event link, its average, its difference from that overall average, and its difference from the mean of the qualifying events’ averages; return the 10 largest final differences

queries:
WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_average
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_average, oa.average_amount
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ea.event_average > oa.average_amount
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    event_average,
    event_average - average_amount AS difference_from_overall,
    event_average - (SELECT AVG(event_average) FROM qualifying_events) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying_events
ORDER BY difference_from_qualifying_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_average
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_average
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ea.event_average > oa.average_amount
),
pooled_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN qualifying_events AS qe ON qe.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    qe.link_to_event,
    qe.event_average,
    qe.event_average - oa.average_amount AS difference_from_overall,
    qe.event_average - pa.average_amount AS difference_from_pooled
FROM qualifying_events AS qe
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN pooled_average AS pa
ORDER BY difference_from_pooled DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_average
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(event_average) AS overall_mean
    FROM event_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_average, o.overall_mean
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ea.event_average > o.overall_mean
),
qualifying_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(event_average) AS mean_average
    FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
    q.link_to_event,
    q.event_average,
    q.event_average - q.overall_mean AS difference_from_overall_mean,
    q.event_average - qm.mean_average AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS qm
ORDER BY difference_from_qualifying_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_average
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(event_average) AS mean_average
    FROM event_averages
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_average, om.mean_average
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
    WHERE ea.event_average > om.mean_average
),
pooled_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(b.amount) AS pooled_mean
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN qualifying_events AS q ON b.link_to_event = q.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    q.link_to_event,
    q.event_average,
    q.event_average - q.mean_average AS difference_from_overall_mean,
    q.event_average - p.pooled_mean AS difference_from_pooled_average
FROM qualifying_events AS q
CROSS JOIN pooled_average AS p
ORDER BY difference_from_pooled_average DESC
LIMIT 10
